journey.name: Wear - New Post by Keyboard
journey.description:
Verifies writing a post on the watch: the text is typed on the Wear keyboard, reviewed, changed, posted, shown as "Posting…" at the top of the feed and then stays there as a normal post. Also covers a post that fails and is retried, and a phone that cannot post.
Run on a round Wear OS emulator with the bench build. Start with the app stopped. Type by tapping the on-screen keys: text injected with "adb shell input text" is shown by the Wear keyboard but never returned to the app (see docs/wear-testing.md). The bench build holds a post for 10 seconds before it settles; "post_fails" makes it fail.

actions.action: Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "default"
Tap New post
Verify that the system text input screen is shown with the label "New post"
Tap the keyboard choice
Type "hello watch" by tapping the on-screen keys
Verify that the keyboard's text field reads "Hello watch"
Tap the keyboard's Send key
Verify that a review screen titled "New post" shows the text "Hello watch", the count "11 / 300", and the buttons Change and Post
Verify that the clock at the top of the screen does not overlap the title
Tap Change
Verify that the system text input screen is shown again
Tap the keyboard choice, type "second try" by tapping the on-screen keys, and tap the keyboard's Send key
Verify that the review screen shows the text "Second try" and the count "10 / 300", and no longer shows "Hello watch"
Tap Post
Verify that the feed "Following" is shown with "Second try" at the top, marked "Posting…"
Wait 12 seconds
Verify that "Second try" is still the first post in the feed, now by Nubecita with the time "now" and without "Posting…"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown, not the review screen
Tap Home
Verify that "Second try" is still the first post in the feed
Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "post_fails"
Tap New post, tap the keyboard choice, type "will fail" by tapping the on-screen keys, tap the keyboard's Send key, and tap Post
Verify that the feed shows "Will fail" at the top, marked "Posting…"
Wait 12 seconds
Verify that "Will fail" shows "Not posted — tap to retry"
Tap "Will fail"
Verify that "Will fail" shows "Posting…" again
Wait 12 seconds
Verify that "Will fail" shows "Not posted — tap to retry" and appears only once in the feed
Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "no_posting"
Verify that the landing screen shows New post as unavailable
Tap New post
Verify that the landing screen is still shown and no text input screen opened
